name: Mind the Offline Provider
tagline: Check availability before choosing a fee.
brief: Route payments through the cheapest provider that is actually online.
context: Provider A has the lowest fee, but it is offline. Provider B is available.
narrative:
The starter rule sends every payment to Provider A because its fee is lower. That route cannot succeed while A is offline.

Fix the policy by checking whether a provider can accept work before using its price. A cheap route is useful only when it is available.
objective: Process every payment with no failures and avoid the offline provider.
learningObjective: Apply hard constraints first, then optimise among the options that remain.
intelligenceExplanation:
The provider cards show that A is cheaper but unavailable, while B is online. Replace the starter route with an available route.

The queue should clear without a failed attempt.
hint: Use the available fallback: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
hints: Look at the provider cards — one is marked offline. Routing there fails.
The starter rule sends everything to A. Change it: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
B is the cheaper available provider in this fixed scenario.
